name: kitkat
description: The definitive open-source developer toolkit for WebMCP (Web Model Context Protocol). Postman for WebMCP, fully client-side and local.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n core,extension,server -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev -w @kitkat/core" "npm run dev -w kitkat-extension" "npm run dev -w kitkat-server"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @kitkat/core && npm run build -w kitkat-extension && npm run build -w kitkat-server && npm run build -w kitkat-web
